editorial:
Imagine you are sitting in a quiet roadside diner when a dying man suddenly claims he has hidden a million dollars in four different spots. Instead of just telling everyone where the cash is, he gives the patrons a set of tricky riddles to solve. You get to watch a group of complete strangers turn into desperate treasure hunters, all fighting and teaming up to figure out the clues. It is a wild ride that feels like a giant game of hide-and-seek where the stakes are incredibly high and the tension keeps building as the clock ticks down.

You will love how the movie keeps you guessing with its fast pace and funny character clashes. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the quirky vibe of the story perfectly. The biggest downside is that it feels like a TV movie from the 80s, but that actually adds to the charm. If you enjoy mysteries that make you think along with the characters, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a collector, try to track down the physical disc to add to your shelf.
endingExplained: After racing through various locations to solve the riddles, the characters finally find the hidden money. However, the big twist is that the dying man played a long game with them. The struggle and greed of the group prove that they do not deserve the wealth. In the end, the money is not as simple to get as they thought, and the story wraps up by showing how greed can turn friends into enemies very quickly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scavenger hunts and ensemble casts.
